description: Remove a user from a group chat. The bot must be an admin of the chat. Optionally block the user from rejoining. WARNING: If the user has privacy mode enabled in MAX settings, the bot will not be able to re-add them after removal — confirm with the user before proceeding.

block.description: Block user from rejoining the chat (default: false)

chat_id.description: The chat_id of the group chat

user_id.description: The user_id of the member to remove

name: remove_member
title: Remove Member
